verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own developer stack (AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub/GenieX) explicitly documents NPU/GPU/CPU support and lists ONNX Runtime and LiteRT as target on-device runtimes for Snapdragon X-series chips, satisfying the 'vendor's own AI software stack' clause. However, the evidence never mentions llama.cpp or MLX support, and since the X2 Elite Extreme itself only launches in 2026, none of the docs confirm runtime support specifically validated on this exact new silicon (only the general X-series family). Missing for 10: llama.cpp/MLX documentation, independent confirmation of runtime support on the actual X2 Elite Extreme chip, and benchmarked inference results.
